Name: Cozy Hut House
Author: zilchaz
Description:
Redesign Island buildings to look cozier.

[list]
[*]You need to install the latest version of SMAPI﻿ and Content Patcher﻿.
[*]Drop the content of this zip file in your mod folder: [i]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]
[/list]
[b]
Configuration:[/b]
[list]
[*]Recolor: "Default" or "Desaturated"
[*]set "True" or "False" for IslandFarmhouse, BirdieHut, Juice Bar, the resort, and umbrella separately
[/list]
--

Thanks to [b]NARCOAZAZAL[/b] for the desaturated assets.

Mods used in screenshots:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - Reshade[/url]﻿ - color filter
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Stardew Foliage Redone - A Nature Toned Map Recolour[/url]﻿ - recolor
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7924]Hot Air Balloon Obelisks[/url]﻿[/b] - my obelisks mod
[/list]
